CapabilityExecutorResponse.description:
Scientist-safe scheduling characteristics for a governed capability.

Native service coordinates, protocol fields, and health contracts belong to
the restricted runtime registry. They must never be serialized through the
authenticated scientist contract.
CapabilityExecutorResponse.title: CapabilityExecutorResponse

CapabilityRowScopeContractResponse.description: Universal row/batch semantics derived from the executable capability contract.
CapabilityRowScopeContractResponse.title: CapabilityRowScopeContractResponse

DatasetVersionPublishRequest.description:
Publish a complete immutable successor snapshot.

Callers send the complete desired snapshot rather than an in-place patch.  The
service verifies the exact parent and Dataset revision before atomically moving
the Dataset's current-version pointer.
DatasetVersionPublishRequest.title: DatasetVersionPublishRequest
